description: Unit tests for the NetworkQualityStore component in the net/nqe module, focusing on caching behavior, signal strength handling, and cache size limits.

methods.name: TestCaching
methods.description: Tests adding, retrieving, overwriting, and non-existence of network quality cache entries based on network ID and effective connection type.

methods.name: TestCachingClosestSignalStrength
methods.description: Verifies cache behavior with different signal strengths, ensuring closest match retrieval and handling of unknown signal strength.

methods.name: TestCachingUnknownSignalStrength
methods.description: Checks cache behavior when signal strength is unknown (INT32_MIN), ensuring correct retrieval and closest match logic.

methods.name: TestLRUCacheMaximumSize
methods.description: Ensures cache size remains bounded, implements LRU eviction, and verifies correct cache entries after exceeding maximum size.
